honesty_notice: This is an analysis specification for the post-rejection corrected archive. It is NOT a prospective pre-registration fixed before seeing the data. The prior PHASE3_PREREGISTRATION.json incorrectly embedded finished coefficients and pass/fail verdicts inside the plan file; that practice is discontinued.

supported: Frequency-titration consistency: in Iaccarino VC ELISA (n=18), greater assigned flicker mismatch from 40 Hz associates with lower Aβ1-40 reduction vs dark baseline.
Etter complete tri-frequency subset (n=7) is underpowered; report point estimate with permutation CI; do not claim personalization validation.
Population-level Brian2/digital-twin simulation is hypothesis-generating only.
not_supported: Personalized gamma entrainment validated in individuals.
Independent out-of-sample prediction of unseen experiments.
Pooled n=28 ML as confirmatory evidence.
28 Hz as a robust empirical stimulation optimum.
Etter plaque burden paired by mouse ID (values exist anonymously; ID link unverified).

P1_primary.inclusion: All VC 1 hr flicker animals in Extended Data Table 1 arms 20/40/80 Hz
tests: Spearman rho with permutation p-value and bootstrap CI
Mann-Whitney close vs far on fractional reduction
P1_primary.interpretation_limit: Confirms published frequency titration (40 Hz superior to 20/80), not an individualized frequency-mismatch mechanism.

S1_secondary.exclusion_reason: Only 10 Hz stim/baseline reported; 40 and 80 Hz missing in MOESM4 fig_2n
S1_secondary.predictor: abs(preferred_stim_frequency_hz - 40) where preferred=argmax of measured ratios
tests: Spearman rho with permutation p-value and bootstrap CI
S1_secondary.power: Compute Fisher-z approximate power at n=7 for |rho|=0.5 and 0.7 and for observed |rho|
S1_secondary.interpretation_limit: Underpowered consistency check; not confirmatory of personalization.

phase2_composite_policy.headline_optimum_rule: Primary reported optimum uses equal weights on usable (non-identically-zero) z-scored components. GC-only optima are sensitivity analyses only.
